title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta15

## Stable Target zone while docked

This beta fixes a navigation-state arbitration edge case seen on docked mowers that periodically publish a fresh XY pose while the private cloud still correctly reports Docked.

- Trust the coordinator's already-resolved docked state in the navigation layer instead of re-confirming Docked from pose freshness, dock-zone geometry or a fresh MQTT dock state.
- Prevent a periodic dock-position heartbeat from briefly reviving retained `work_target_zone`, `partition_ids` or `current_zone_ids` from the last mowing task.
- Keep **Target zone** at **No active target** while the mower remains confirmed docked, both while the dock pose is fresh and after it becomes stale.
- Preserve optimistic command behavior: a fresh Mow/Resume/Return transition still overrides an older private-cloud docked state immediately, so newly commanded targets remain visible without waiting for cloud state convergence.
- Add dependency-free regressions covering the dock-heartbeat case, stale-pose continuation and fresh HA mowing command precedence.

No map geometry, mowing progress, History, Schedule, gate intent, MQTT freshness windows or Map Card API contract is changed.
